name: Santa Kiara no Rakuen
original_name: サンタ・キアラの楽園
source:
A certain era. A certain place.
There was a village there.
That village was suffering from a certain illness.
An abominable disease brought from a neighboring village.

Then, a single doctor appeared.
The kind doctor said:
"I'll cure everyone's illness!"

Having said this, the young man immediately set off.
To the neighboring village, the source of the disease.
To that village, proclaimed as paradise—.

[Translated from the [url=https://mamemaru092.wixsite.com/mamemaru09/複製-虚妄のサンタ-カタリナ]official site[/url]]
translation:
某个时代。某个地方。
那里有一个村庄。
那个村庄患上了某种疾病。
一种从邻村带来的可怕疾病。

然后，出现了一位医生。
善良的医生说：
“我会治好大家的病！”

说完这句话，青年立即出发了。
至邻村，为病源。
前往那个被誉为天堂的村庄——。

【翻译自[url=https://mamemaru092.wixsite.com/mamemaru09/複製-虚妄のサンタ-カタリナ]官网[/url]】
